Bills to customer for water and sewer service shall be mailed out on such day or days each month as may be determined as desirable by the Town. The failure of water and/or sewer users to pay charges duly imposed shall result in the automatic imposition of the following penaities:

CA) Nonpayment within ten (10) days from the due date will he subject to a penalty of ten percent (10%) of the delinquent account.

(B) Nonpayment within twenty (20) days from the date due will result in the water being shut off fron the water user's property.

(C) Nonpayment for sixty (60) days after original billing date will allow the Town, in addition to all other rights and remedies, to terminate agreement, and in such event, the water user Shall not be entitied to receive, nor the Town obligated to supply, any water under this agreement.

Water and sewer service shall not be reconnected until customer's celinquent bill, including penalty and disconnection charges, have been paid in full.

Should such customer thereafter desire to be reconnected to the water and sewer system, a re-connection charge of $10.00 Shall he

collected. Bills shall be paid at the Town Hall of Town of Pine Mountain and a failure to receive bilis and notices shall not prevent such bills from becoming delinquent nor relieve the consumer fron paynent of same.

(B) Service disconnected for nonpayment of bills will be restored oniy after all smounts which are owed sre paid in full, such security deposit as may be required by the Mayor and Council is made, and a service charge as quoted in paragraph 10 (C) for each meter reconnected.

AN ORDINANCE to regulate the providing of water and sewer services provided by the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia; to provide an effective date; and for other purposes.

BE IT ORDAINED that the Town of Pine Mountain hereby adopts the following Ordinance to regulate the providing of water and sewer services in the Town and adjacent areas.

Section One:

The Superintendent of Public Works is authorized to sell and deliver water and sewer services to customers at sites located wholly within the corporate limits of the Town at rates approved by the Town Council, and in accordance with and subject to this article and other applicable laws and ordinances and rules and regulations lawfully made and promulgated by the Superintendent pertaining thereto.

Section Two: Sales and delivery of water and sewer services to customers at sites located outside the corporate limits of the Town shall be allowed only with the express approval of the Town Council.

Section Three: All ordinances or parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby expressly repealed.
